# Mow Pro GA (Mow Pro Lawn Care LLC)

> Locally owned residential lawn care company in Douglasville, Georgia. Biweekly mowing with edging, weed eating, and blow-off included, plus leaf removal, fall cleanups, and hedge and shrub trimming. 5-star rated on Google. No contracts. Free instant quotes online.

- Website: https://mowproga.com
- Phone / text: 404-669-6945
- Address: 1695 Hampton Pass, Douglasville, GA 30134
- Service area: Douglasville and Douglas County, GA, including Lithia Springs, Villa Rica, Powder Springs, Stewarts Mill, Shallowford Heights, Springwood Village, and the Big A / Highway 166 area
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 9 AM–6 PM
- Payment: Zelle, Cash App, card (Stripe invoice), or cash, due the day of service

## Lawn mowing (biweekly, everything included)

Every visit includes mowing, edging, weed eating, and blowing debris off driveways and walkways.

- Small yard (under 5,000 sq ft): $55 per visit
- Medium yard (5,000-10,000 sq ft): $70 per visit
- Large yard (10,000-20,000 sq ft): $90 per visit
- Extra large / acreage (over 20,000 sq ft): custom quote
- Overgrown first cut: 2x the normal cut price, covering the first 2 hours, then $55/hour
- Grass over 12 inches: custom quote
- Edge restoration: $25+
- Sidewalk and driveway crack weed spray: $15

## Leaf removal and fall cleanup

Leaves are blown off the lawn, beds, and hard surfaces into a pile on-site by default.

- Small yard: $130+
- Medium yard: $260+
- Large yard: $400+
- Extra large or heavy tree coverage: custom quote
- Bag and haul away: $5-8 per bag
- Regular mowing clients get a discounted leaf rate

## Hedge and shrub trimming

Includes trimming and shaping, with beds and walkways blown off and clippings piled on-site. $100 minimum per visit.

- 1-6 shrubs: $100+
- 7-12 shrubs: $200+
- 13-25 shrubs: $350+
- Shrubs 6-10 ft tall: +$40 each
- Haul away clippings: +$40
- 25+ shrubs, long hedge rows, shrubs over 10 ft, or badly overgrown: custom quote
- Mowing clients get 10% off hedge trimming added to a regular visit

All prices are estimates. Our team confirms the final price after seeing the property.
